We are three engineers from Georgia Tech. We have been building autonomous systems since before we could vote.

Robbie built racing drones in a garage, founded a national championship drone team in high school, and spent years at the frontier of American autonomous flight. Marc led that same team to another championship, then studied the computer science that makes autonomy work. Ben trained inside one of the largest missile programs on earth, saw the limits of legacy systems firsthand, and chose to start over.
We did not read about this problem in a whitepaper. We grew up inside it. We know what drones can do because we have spent our lives making them do it.
Now we build what stops them.
